what_happened: The launcher was invoked and refused before any provider resource existed. Two defects surfaced, both $0 and both now repaired with regressions: the authorization document could not be read back by its own loader, and run_session raised so the run was never recorded -- which is why this closeout exists and why the next attempt takes a new id.

consumed_chain._why: a chain is consumed by the launcher's invocation, whether or not a provider resource followed, and is never reused. The incrementing attempt number is not a scope expansion (P12.1).

next: attempt2, under a fresh chain on the repaired tree
